items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I think I played with him there like for 5 nights or something, and then we went on the road. That's when I joined him.

ctx.x: Yeah, once. Yes. Once. That's when

I first joined them. That is correct. The Tiffany -- we played the Tiffany. I think I played with him there like for 5 nights or something, and then we went on the road. That's when I joined him. But when you join a group like that, you don't do anything but bring your instrument in, you have no rehearsal, no nothing, you know.

It was right at the time -- I skipped over this, but before I went with Nat, my son and I were living alone, and Oscar Peterson trio at the time consisted of Irvin Ashby, Ray Brown and Oscar Peterson, so something happened to Ashby and Oscar and Ray had this engagement in Aspen, Colorado, and one evening about 6:30, here they come by my house and they were really a lot of fun.
